title: Advance affine dynamics with classical RK4
prompt: Implement solve(payload) for scalar dynamics dy/dt=rate_per_s*y+forcing_per_s. Use classical explicit fourth-order Runge-Kutta, not the exact exponential solution: k1=f(y), k2=f(y+h*k1/2), k3=f(y+h*k2/2), k4=f(y+h*k3); next=y+h*(k1+2*k2+2*k3+k4)/6. initial is y at time zero; step_s is h>0 and steps must be an integer from 0 through 1000 (a Boolean is not an integer here). Return {"values":[initial,y_after_one_step,...]} with steps+1 entries. Invalid step_s or steps returns {"error":"invalid_steps"}. The rate has units 1/s, forcing has units y/s, and h is seconds. Tests stay in a finite numerical range. Any numeric inputs are finite; inputs have the documented shapes; unspecified validation is out of scope. Do not mutate payload or any nested value. Numeric absolute tolerance 1e-9, relative tolerance 1e-9; strings, booleans, errors and collection shapes must match exactly.
